name: trial-L4
eval: (()=>{const n=rung,D=vals.rad;const rot=(p,i,j,th)=>{const c=Math.cos(th),s=Math.sin(th),a=p[i],b=p[j];p[i]=c*a-s*b;p[j]=s*a+c*b;};const from=(k0,v)=>{let p=v.slice();for(let k=k0;k<n;k++){const pl=SCHED[k%SCHED.length];let th=(oscOn&&oscBlend>0)?((1-oscBlend)*ph[k]+oscBlend*oscAmp*Math.sin(ph[k])):ph[k];th*=(k===n-1?growth:1);rot(p,pl[0],pl[1],th);}return p;};let tot=from(0,[D,0,0]);for(let c=1;c<=Math.floor((n-1)/2);c++){const d=selfScale?kHole*Math.pow(kHole+1,c-1)*D:vals.disp*Math.pow(1/RATIOS[dispRatioId].base,c-1);const q=from(2*c,[d,0,0]);tot=[tot[0]+q[0],tot[1]+q[1],tot[2]+q[2]];}const real=buildRaw();return {level:n,err:Math.hypot(real[0]-tot[0],real[1]-tot[1],real[2]-tot[2])}})()
